name: Learn basic cup stacking
blurb: Sport stacking is a pure speed-and-pattern skill with an unambiguous score. The 3-3-3 and 3-6-3 sequences take an afternoon to learn and weeks to get properly fast.
gear: A set of 12 sport stacking cups (regular plastic cups stick together)
steps: Learn the 3-3-3: three pyramids up and down, left to right, using both hands simultaneously.
Learn the 3-6-3: a three-stack, a six-stack, a three-stack, up and down.
Fix the fundamentals — both hands move at once, cups stay on the table, no cup is ever lifted higher than needed.
Time every attempt and log it. The scoreboard is what makes this addictive.
Learn the cycle: 3-6-3, then 6-6, then 1-10-1, back to 3-6-3.
Work down towards sub-10 seconds on the cycle.
tips: Both hands, always. A one-handed habit caps your speed permanently.
A smooth table surface matters more than you would expect.
proof: You run the full cycle cleanly, in under 15 seconds, on video.
